emptyCopy: You can compare once you've saved two property checks. We put score, facts and your personal fit side by side.
step1Text: Open a property check you want to remember.
step3Text: That's where you'll see the differences in one place.
errorPartial: One or more property analyses are temporarily unavailable. Please try again shortly.
errorLoadFailed: The comparison could not be fully loaded. Please try again.
dashboardCopy: The fixed Reality Score stays comparable; your personal fit uses your saved preferences.
footnote: Asking price, rooms, listing m², label and VvE contribution come from your saved Funda details (login required); without a listing we show "Unknown".
placesEmptyTitle: Which neighborhood or municipality fits best?
placesEmptyCopy: Open a place page (neighborhood, municipality or locality) and choose "Compare" there. After two places you can line them up here.
placeStep1Text: On the home page you can also search neighborhoods and municipalities.
placeStep2Text: The button is on every place page.
placeStep3Text: Then you'll see the figures side by side.
placesDashCopy: CBS neighborhood averages and open-data signals per area. These are environmental indications — not a property check.
placesDisclaimer: Signals are averages for the whole area; a single street can differ substantially. Open data is no substitute for an inspection or advice.
